edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: square 1:1 3x3 challenge-menu poster for Beat my track.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the three-panel forest/desert/winter poster. Input image 2 is ONLY the fictional classic hatchback construction, ivory/navy livery and cel-shading reference.
Primary request: fix the INCORRECT CAR POSE AND ROAD ALIGNMENT in ALL THREE panels. The current car looks copied into each scene at a diagonal, facing across the local track. Replace that pose completely.
Keep exactly three equal horizontal scenic panels with the same thin navy dividers, top forest / middle desert / bottom snow, same quiet natural scenery, same three-lens starter board on the left of each track, same mature matte cel-shaded 3D style and square edge-to-edge framing. Do not redesign the triptych or add anything.
Correct pose: in EVERY panel the SAME ivory-and-navy classic boxy rally hatchback is viewed from an elevated REAR THREE-QUARTER angle, standing straight on the starting straight and pointing FORWARD AWAY from the viewer along the road into the scene. Show the rear hatch, two coherent rear lamp clusters, rear bumper, rear glass, roof and the side of the car; NO front grille or headlights facing the viewer. Realistic car proportions, quiet broad surfaces and plausible wheels. Keep the full car inside the frame, near the centre of the road and comparable in scale across panels.
The local starting straight must run from the lower foreground toward the upper-right distance, with the road centreline passing through the car's front/rear axle midpoints. Car FRONT is upper-right, REAR is lower-left; the rear-to-front chassis direction exactly follows the tangent of that straight road. Allow the road to bend only WELL AHEAD of the car. No diagonal parking pose, no sideways skid, no yaw relative to the lane, no drift, no body roll or banked car, no lifted wheels. Front wheels point straight, parallel to the rear wheels and road. All four tyre contact patches rest on the SAME road plane, at correct wheelbase/track width; coherent tyre ellipses and perspective, no stretched/misaligned axles.
Place a SINGLE modest black-and-white start stripe directly BEHIND the rear wheels, transverse across the road, with its long edge PERPENDICULAR to the car's direction of travel and its checks following the road-plane perspective. The two axles and the start stripe must be parallel in world space. Do not use the old diagonal stripe or pose. Both road edges pass clearly outside the car's four tyre contacts with visible road clearance.
You may redraw ONLY the car, its shadow, the start stripe and the immediate starting straight as needed to solve this geometry. Preserve the scenery, panel boundaries, three amber lenses per starter board, fictional vehicle identity and clean colour-band shading. The three cars are the same entrant ready to drive onward through three different venues, not three cars posed for a camera.
No text, words, numbers, logos, manufacturer badges, watermark, arrows, tyre smoke or speed lines. No photographic texture, glossy reflections, bloom or plastic toy treatment. Keep the dimensional cel-shaded look.

No extra objects, arrows, tyre marks, text, numbers, logos or borders. Keep the existing mature matte cel-shaded 3D style. Square 1:1 output.
